Ten recurring symptoms

A taxonomy of
being online.

Ten editorial collections give the brand somewhere to go beyond a single joke. Together they cover the systems, rituals, and small humiliations of contemporary digital life.

01

Social Media Theater

Thought leadership, promotions, public performance, and career journeys nobody asked to follow.“Delighted to announce I remain employed.”

02

Algorithm Anxiety

Engagement systems, recommendations, benchmarks, relevance, and computational validation.“My self-worth is buffering.”

03

Creator Economy

Personal brands, monetized memories, candid takes, funnels, and audience dependence.“Everything is content if you disrespect the moment enough.”

04

Chronically Online

Doomscrolling, notifications, read receipts, attention, and the inconvenience of offline life.“Offline is currently unavailable.”

05

Artificial Authenticity

Edited vulnerability, automated relatability, genuine prompts, and human-generated errors.“Please excuse the human-generated errors.”

06

Future of Work

Beta coworkers, autonomous supervision, valuations, and labor that needs a software update.“Your replacement is currently rebooting.”

07

Productivity Theater

Alignment, calendar identity, status updates, deep work, and looking operationally excellent.“Busy is my core competency.”

08

Performative Sustainability

Renewable outrage, carbon-neutral decks, offsets, incentives, and branded water bottles.“Reduce. Reuse. Overnight delivery.”

09

Terms and Conditions

Subscription lives, premium personalities, free trials, privacy with ads, and forgotten memberships.“Basic personality. Premium features.”

10

Optimized Human

Competitive mindfulness, tracked sleep, recovery routines, wellness metrics, and quantified self-care.“Mindfulness, but competitively.”
